Added the `EventListener.BatchDurable` callback, `WriteOptions.CommitCorrelationID`, `Metrics` durability counters, and the `DB` durability tracking and waiting APIs on branch `batch-durable`:

- **Event Listener & Options** ([event.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/event.go), [options.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/options.go)):
  - Added [`BatchDurableInfo`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/event.go#L920-L954) (`JobID`, `SeqNum`, `Err`, `ApplyDuration`, `SyncDuration`, `CorrelationID`, `BatchSize`, `KeyCount`) and `EventListener.BatchDurable func(BatchDurableInfo)`.
  - Added `CommitCorrelationID uint64` and [`GetCommitCorrelationID`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/options.go#L52-L58) on [`WriteOptions`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/options.go#L35-L45).
  - Wired `BatchDurable` through [`EventListener.EnsureDefaults`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/event.go#L1080-L1092), [`MakeLoggingEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/event.go#L1181-L1191), and [`TeeEventListener`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/event.go#L1273-L1290).
- **Commit Pipeline & Durability Tracking** ([durability.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go), [commit.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/commit.go), [batch.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/batch.go), [db.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/db.go), [open.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/open.go)):
  - Tracked per-Sync commit wall-clock apply and WAL sync durations, firing `BatchDurable` once per Sync commit after the WAL sync completes (including on failure and `Batch.SyncWait`), while skipping non-sync commits and `DisableWAL`.
  - Implemented [`WaitForDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L615-L617) / [`WaitForDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L622-L624), [`WaitForDurabilityBatch`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L628-L630) / [`WaitForDurabilityBatchContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L636-L638), [`WaitForJobDurability`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L642-L644) / [`WaitForJobDurabilityContext`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L649-L651), [`DurableState`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L655-L657), [`DurabilityNotify`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L662-L664), and [`DurabilityStats`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability.go#L667-L669).
- **Metrics & Tests** ([metrics.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/metrics.go), [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability_test.go)):
  - Added `DurableCommitCount` and `DurableCommitDuration` to [`Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/metrics.go#L276-L284) (populated in [`DB.Metrics`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/db.go#L2300-L2303) when `BatchDurable` is configured).
  - Added unit and concurrency tests in [durability_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-nm2qhb5_/durability_test.go).
